comparison: exact signed integer outputs, complete Voice storage and runtime caches after every frame; no state injection after initialization
golden_format: UTF-8 CSV with unique named columns; raw unsigned storage values, signed intermediate stage values; frame is the zero-based frame being completed, sampleClock is post-step
synthetic_rom: 1048576 bytes: byte[i]=(i*73+(i>>8)+19)&255; exponent area i<32768 replaced by (i%11)|(((i+3)%11)<<4); source in host/voice_reference/main.cpp

interface.voice_step: xp3_voice_step(frame_context, voice_state, wave_bytes, defer_filter, result); state is caller-owned and advances once per native frame
interface.frame_context: sampleClock:u64, voiceIndex:u6, irqStatus:u16, irqConfigMask:u16, interrupt:bool, acceptedThisFrame:bool, irqBlockedEvent:bool, eight CS descriptors and mappings
interface.wave_mapping: per CS: base:u25, size:u25, physical16:bool, voiceBankShift:u4, descriptor:u8; decoded bytes, shared read-only address space of 20971520 bytes; unmapped/out-of-range reads return zero as pinned XP
interface.result: interpolated signed20 sample, filterDue:bool, prior signed24 filterOutput for next-stage mixing, updated signed24 output in Voice state; IRQ updates retain actual voice index
interface.pair_filter: xp3_pair_filter(owner_state, partner_state, owner_sample, partner_sample): owner structure 2..10, booster, modes, both TVA gains; owner receives final output, partner output is zero
interface.pair_order: advance each source once at the same global clock with defer_filter=true, retaining pre-source TVA smoothing; then run pair filter if either filterDue; do not duplicate or skip source/ramp updates
interface.reset: power reset clears global/context and every Voice field; voice release reset parks runtime phase and clears filters on step, decays TVA with max(1,7*gain>>3), does not reset global sampleClock; release commits on host mask read
interface.host_updates: apply recorded host writes/read side effects before the frame; seed only the declared initial state, never load expected runtime state to repair drift
interface.scope: single Voice numerical engine plus explicitly paired TVF/TVA operation, not DDR cache, multi-Voice scheduling, XP DSP/LSP or I2S

stage_columns.interpolation: a=unpacked phase, b=interpolated signed sample; c..h=0
stage_columns.filter: a=input, b=mode, c=nextLp, d=highPass, e=nextBp, f=selected, g=unsigned frequency, h=unsigned damping
stage_columns.tva: a=input, b=unsigned gain=tvaGain<<4, c=saturated output; d..h=0
stage_columns.voice: ROM-read and stage CSV voice column is the offset 0/1 within the observed pair; state columns retain physical Voice indices

reference_limits: Reserved FCE exponents 11..15 produce zero delta and zero interpolation contribution, matching pinned reference, not a silicon claim
Descriptor bit 1, physical 8-bit reverse preload, nonzero launch counters and LDPCM producer modifier retain pinned upstream ordinary-path behaviour
The name PCM identifies the PCM sample engine; no invented raw-PCM mode bypasses the three documented pinned DPCM formats
100 MHz is a synthesis target only; II, latency, resources and achievable clock remain UNVERIFIED until actual HLS reports
